parameters.description:
Parameters for the standalone simulation report task.

This task reads existing simulation results from a grid and generates a validation
report (validation.json) containing CDF, quantile, summary statistics, swath plots,
and variogram reproduction data.

block_discretization.description: Sub-block discretization used for support correction within each grid block.

nx.title: Number of subdivisions in the x direction

ny.title: Number of subdivisions in the y direction

nz.description: Number of subdivisions in the z direction
nz.title: Number of subdivisions in the z direction
